Whether actual civilisations are so coupled, or capacities lost in one place survive in another, is supplied, not shown: the historical condition is not claimed. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45, D61]: a boundary short of the whole is real, since its relation never crosses it, and relative to that relation.

Thesis, argued: forbids an explanation needing a determination no relation carries, such as a self with a nature of its own. Two live arguments would defeat it: that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates.

Theorem (any types; a witness): where the world answers the act chosen with the value sensed and stays, the formation rests at once on a model its course never refutes. Reading [AI]: a model right along its course and wrong off it, related to self-confirming equilibrium (Fudenberg and Levine 1993); what tells such worlds apart comes from beyond the formation's own selection.

reading.en: The account takes up the self and its boundary and says otherwise. 08 forbids an explanation needing a self with a nature of its own, near the source's 'no independent self', yet 01 keeps boundaries: one short of the whole is real, relative to its relation, so a fitted model keeps its boundary. Quiet as evidence of fit meets a law: a formation can rest on a model its course never refutes, wrong off that course, so no error from inside does not tell fit from an untested model; that application is this read's. 逍遥 as a state has no home. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery; admitted transitions supplied): 'a change recorded as none can leave false confidence'; 'a control change can reopen an excluded arrangement'. What execution needs certified is the acquisition-time candidate set propagated through every admitted change. Its record: the admitted changes are not shown to be the actual ones, and 'a passing certificate warrants only what faithful domains warrant'.

The configured checks read statements from Lean source text, not from elaborated terms, so a premise named only through a definition that a statement unfolds is not found. K5 looks only for the parameter patterns the coverage file lists.
LA2's rule printed 'the counts decide' as supported while consulting neither the one-note measure nor the first late reading, both of which contradict it.
Each item in the last column is a limit that holds so far and lapses when the account states the result.

A law with content stands or falls by its check. An observation reaches it only through a stated correspondence, so a conclusion failing in a domain shows that the domain does not meet the hypotheses or that the correspondence misreads them, not that the theorem is false. A thesis claiming that the domain meets them does fail there.

reading.en: The account states the form on a periphery model: a change recorded as none can leave false confidence, a certificate passing while what it certified has moved, the admitted changes supplied. Its method shows the practice: checks reading Lean source text miss a premise named through a definition; LA2's rule printed a verdict both its measures contradict; a limit holds so far and lapses with its reason. Where the source's guard 'becomes false', a theorem does not: a domain ceasing to meet its hypotheses defeats the correspondence. [AI reading]
